counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.0297659 to 0.005 (single field) with same 24 steps; close encounter then resolved accurately and no rule violated.

explanation: Two heavy bodies (idx 2 m~15.67 and idx 4 m~17.40) undergo a close approach: separation 1.458 at step 20 -> 0.589 at step 23 -> 0.120 at step 24, reaching speeds ~10. With dt near maximum (~0.0298) and substeps capped at 6 per step, the leapfrog substepping cannot resolve the rapidly deepening softened potential (-458 -> -998 -> -2011) and kinetic spike (237 -> 787 -> 1624), so total energy jumps by 166 (allowed 72.7), i.e. failed adaptive substepping during a heavy-body close encounter.
vision_note: On the right side, two larger blue bodies converge from clearly separated in step 21 to touching in steps 22-23. By step 24 they fully overlap into a single larger blob while the other bodies on the left and center remain distant and stationary.
